notes: One screen by default, like Bullpup: the top screen in Bullpup's screen area, SWAP brings the touch screen up in its place. Both screens (stacked or side by side) are still in Look, Screens
Smoother: frames are paced to the screen instead of run in bursts, and the sound adjusts by up to half a percent to stay in step
Faster: 3D is drawn on a second CPU core, and RAM reads skip the address decoder
